items.title: American Veteran Contracting Solutions, LLC
items.decisionLine: We sustain the protest in part and deny it in part.
items.officialSynopsis: American Veteran Contracting Solutions, LLC, a service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB) of Mesa, Arizona, protests the award of a...
items.digest: 1. Protest challenging the agency's decision to select the lowest-priced, technically acceptable offer for award is denied where the agency's selection was in accordance with the plain language of the solicitation. 2. Protest challenging the agency's evaluation of the awardee's technical proposal is denied where the record shows that the agency's evaluation was reasonable and consistent with the terms of the solicitation. 3. Protest that agency held unequal discussions is sustained where the record shows that the agency engaged in an additional round of discussions with only the awardee.
items.practitionerNote: Evaluation records need traceable reasoning. The file should show what the evaluators read, why it mattered, and how the same standard was applied across offerors.
